rows.en: Curse you, Gavan!! But I… I will never die until I've defeated you!
Iiiih! Iiiih!
Why did you come running back? You coward!!
Gugh…
Hunter Killer! Throw this one back into his stone cell!
Y-yes, sir!

The bio-fusion device is mine! I'll create one ultimate Double Monster after another!

Gavan! I will finish you off…

We may have been outdone by that Sharivan… but rejoice, my King! We have obtained information on the Iga Crystal!

The Iga Crystal is on Oku-Iga Island!
Have you got proof?

Where exactly it is… the precise location, I don't know!

But… it's somewhere on that island… That much I can swear to!
The Iga Crystal I have searched for these 2000 years!?
It is said that whoever holds the Iga Crystal can rule the entire universe! We'll leave no stone unturned and find the Iga Crystal without fail…
Hongo, are you really leaving without a word?

I'd like to see good old Oyassan and Taki too. But if I see them, it'll just be harder to leave Japan again.

My place to fight is in Europe! Give everyone my regards.

Yeah…

A man who fights evil all alone: Takeshi Hongo. You… you really are a true hero, you know that!
You crowned your first mission with a splendid victory, didn't you, Sharivan?

No… It's all thanks to you, Captain Gavan. Thank you very much!

Let me introduce her! This is my partner, Lily.
Nice to meet you, Captain Gavan! My main duties are intelligence gathering and undercover investigation. I look forward to working with you.

Likewise! It's really reassuring to have more comrades. You can never have too many of them!

…!?

What's that? Who could that be?
Captain Gavan!! I'm Dai Sawamura, dispatched from Unit 7 of the Space Sheriff Training Academy.
And I'm Annie, dispatched from Unit 16!
Hold on a second! Why would trainees like you come to Earth aboard a super-dimensional battle carrier?
Captain Gavan… Let me explain that!
Commander!?

Yes… The truth is, Fushigi World Fuuma's Fushigi Song is raging across the planets of the galaxy.

On Planet Omega and many other planets, cities have been destroyed by Fuuma battleships, and Planet Mount was even shattered by a super-powerful bomb… and wiped out entirely.
That was my home… I'm from Planet Mount.
The people of Planet Mount… possess a faint telepathic sensing ability.
I can sense it… This person seems to have telepathic sensing powers.

Regrettably, this is the devastation we face.

Great Emperor Kubilai, who leads the hateful Fushigi World Fuuma, the greatest and mightiest invader in the dark universe, has begun indiscriminate attacks on the entire galaxy!

Against such a formidable enemy, I must now tell these two, only halfway through their training, to set out at once as Space Sheriffs!
Yes, sir! Commander, I'll do my best!
Yes, sir!
Thank you… I proclaim it loudly to the entire universe! Here and now, new Space Sheriffs are born!
I'll fight!!
From today, you are… Space Sheriff Shaider, in charge of the Earth sector!
Space Sheriff Shaider?

That's right… It's your code name!

It comes from the legendary hero said to be the founder of the Galactic Police, the warrior Shaider! Strive to be worthy of that name!

And one more thing…

Annie, who is also a crack shot, will likewise take up duty on Earth to back you up and assist you! I want you two to fight together as partners.
Congratulations, Shaider, Annie!
I'm Space Sheriff Sharivan! And this is my partner, Lily.
Annie… as fellow female Space Sheriffs, let's fight together.
I hate Fuuma! I want to fight Fuuma!
But Fuuma isn't the only evil organization targeting Earth! Personal revenge is strictly off-limits.
I'll fight!
I'm counting on you, Shaider. Let's fight together!!

Yes!

Space Sheriff Shaider! I now take up my duties in charge of the Earth sector! Captain Gavan, I look forward to serving under you.
Right… Give it everything you've got!!
Three Space Sheriffs had gathered on Earth. Sharivan and Shaider, both Earthlings, resolved to walk the harsh road of battle under Captain Gavan to protect their mother planet!
Hayatooo!!
Hayatooo!!
Retsuuu!!
Gavaaan!!
Den!!
Deeen!!
Defeat General Guiler and all Fightlow Soldiers!
Defeat General Guiler and all Fightlow Soldiers! Also seize the laboratory and the factory!
Defeat all Crusher Soldiers, Bem Monsters, Fightlow Soldiers and General Guiler! Also seize the laboratory and the factory!
Defeat all Crusher Soldiers, Bem Monsters, Demon Beasts, Fightlow Soldiers and General Guiler! Also seize the laboratory and the factory!
Defeat all enemies
Hayato Ichimonji or Retsu Ichijouji is defeated
Hayato Ichimonji, Retsu Ichijouji or Den Iga is defeated
All allies are destroyed
<c3>Dai Sawamura</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Dai Sawamura</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!

Destroy! Conquer!

Fushigi World Fuuma wills it… Make Great Emperor Kubilai ruler of the entire dark galaxy!
Babylos, respond! Babylos, respond!
This is Babylos! Dai Sawamura, Unit 7, Space Sheriff Training Academy!
Likewise, Annie, Unit 16!
Both of you, listen carefully. The Commander has something to tell you…
Planet Mount has been wiped out? …Is that true?
It's gone, my home… My home is gone.

Regrettably, this is the devastation we face.

Great Emperor Kubilai, who leads the hateful Fushigi World Fuuma, the greatest and mightiest invader in the dark universe, has begun indiscriminate attacks on your home!

Against such a formidable enemy, I must now tell you two, only halfway through your training, to set out at once as Space Sheriffs!

Thank you… I proclaim it loudly to the entire universe! Here and now, new Space Sheriffs are born!

Sawamura… Fuuma's hand is reaching for your home, Earth, as well.
The entire universe is made up of the Heavenly World, the Earthly World and the Fushigi World.
To thwart the schemes of Fuuma, the invading organization of the Fushigi World, new Space Sheriffs were to be dispatched to Earth.
They were the rookie Dai Sawamura, Space Sheriff Shaider, and his partner, the female Space Sheriff Annie.
Now, leaving Planet Bird behind, the super-dimensional battle mothership Babylos takes off with the two aboard!!
It's going to be a hard fight…
Is the conquest of the whole galaxy not yet complete?
It is proceeding steadily, Your Majesty.

uncertain: U03054: こやつ rendered 'this one… his cell' (Sai Doubler, male).
U03060: Demon King Psycho speaking of searching 2000 years; 'I' assumed.
U03075: マウント星人 rendered 'I'm from Planet Mount'.
U03078/U03121: 臨む read as 率いる (who leads); U03113 臨む read as 望む (wills it). Both glyph guesses.

U03104-U03106: victory conditions are heavily garbled (systematic glyph substitution). Decoded: 報方員=戦闘員, 暴施=将軍, 面=全, 丘獄=制圧, 全士=兵士, ベム夢獣=ベム怪獣, 敵界獣=魔怪獣. 嘸仕悪と掛通 guessed as 研究所と工場 (laboratory and factory) from the pattern in B0037 U02929; please verify in game.
U03107/U03110: 止の面乗 = 敵の全滅 and 急服の面乗 = 味方の全滅 (matches B0028 急服が面乗させられたとき); rendered as condition labels without '!'.
U03125: narration says 新たな宇宙刑事 singular but introduces two; rendered plural.
U03129: 'Your Majesty' added to carry the honorific にございます.

new_names.why: not a standalone glossary key (glossary notes say Fuuma)
by analogy with 戦闘員ミラクラー = Miracler Soldier
following 魔界獣ゴリビースト = Demon Beast Gori Beast

glyph_suspects.likely: 一文字隼人か一条寺烈
